article.title: Penalty for non-compliance of order under section 10.
article.content:
13Penalty for non-compliance of order under section 10.

Section 13  ·  Chapter III  ·  page 12 of the Act
Any person contravening an order of the Special Court made under section 10 shall be punishable with imprisonment for a term which may extend to one year and with fine.
